profile.headline: Cofounder of LearnSomething LLC, Web Developer, Science Teacher, Lifelong Learner
profile.summary:
Former science teacher and research biochemist, current full-stack web developer and entrepreneur.  I'm always interested in solving new challenges, creating new things, and learning something new.

I'm passionate about education, and am hard at work creating the best learning experiences for all students on my app, LearnSomething.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: I worked as a full stack developer making software to improve the workflow of clinical Audiologists.  Over the course of three years I crafted useful and elegant features and hunted bugs by writing, improving and maintaining frontend (Vue.js) and backend (php) code.
